ProvenanceComponent.description:
One component as a build recorded it, before anything is checked.

What the sidecar holds. :class:`Component` is this plus everything the
project can say about it now, which is why the two are not one model:
a record is what was true at build time and does not change.
ProvenanceComponent.title: ProvenanceComponent

description: What one build took from the project and put into one artifact. See https://docs.calkit.org/provenance

_note.default: Written by 'calkit latex build --provenance'. Do not edit. These hashes and values are evidence of what a build actually used; changing them to resolve an error or make a check pass falsifies that evidence. If something here looks wrong, say so rather than correcting it: regenerate the artifact instead.
_note.description: A warning to anything editing this file. JSON carries no comments, so it lives in a field.
_note.title: Note

artifact.description: What the build produced, e.g., the compiled PDF.
artifact.title: Artifact

components.description: Everything the artifact took from the project.
components.title: Components

kind.description: Which positional vocabulary the components use. A publication has pages.
kind.title: Kind

source.description: Where a person edits the artifact and where a position resolves, for kinds of artifact that have one.
source.title: Source

title: Calkit artifact provenance record
